reasoning: The confirmatory test after a reactive HIV screening assay is an HIV-1/HIV-2 antibody differentiation immunoassay, which distinguishes HIV-1 from HIV-2 infection. Genotype testing and Northern/Southern blot options are not the standard confirmatory tests.
